scripts.lint:ssr: eslint . --ext .ts,.tsx --rule 'no-ssr-unsafe/no-ssr-unsafe-browser-api: [warn, {allowGuarded: true, strictMode: false, utilityLeniency: true}]'
scripts.lint:ssr-strict: eslint . --ext .ts,.tsx --rule 'no-ssr-unsafe/no-ssr-unsafe-browser-api: [error, {allowGuarded: true, strictMode: true, utilityLeniency: false}]'
scripts.lint:ssr-lenient: eslint . --ext .ts,.tsx --rule 'no-ssr-unsafe/no-ssr-unsafe-browser-api: [warn, {allowGuarded: true, strictMode: false, utilityLeniency: true}]'
scripts.lint:ssr-debug: eslint . --ext .ts,.tsx --rule 'no-ssr-unsafe/no-ssr-unsafe-browser-api: [warn, {allowGuarded: true, strictMode: false, utilityLeniency: true, debugMode: true}]'
scripts.lint:ssr-count: eslint . --ext .ts,.tsx --rule 'no-ssr-unsafe/no-ssr-unsafe-browser-api: [warn, {allowGuarded: true, strictMode: false, utilityLeniency: true}]' --format compact | grep -c 'no-ssr-unsafe/no-ssr-unsafe-browser-api' || echo '0 errors found'
